title: 第3章
slug: 澶墠鍎垮瓙鍤ｅ紶濡堝挭
content_zh: 第一章 酒吧相遇六年后，A市，最近，一则新闻被闹得沸沸扬扬！天才华裔服装设计师星空即将回国发展！星空，毕业于法国一流的大学，二十一岁时，以一件如梦如幻的白色礼服惊叹了整个时装界，从此跻身顶尖女装设计的行列，三年的时间，似乎拿遍了所有国际性的大奖，更是时尚女王凯琳大师的得意弟子！而这次，她拒绝了法国多家知名集团的邀请，毅然回国。她刚放出要回国的消息，国内一些知名的企业便纷纷抛出橄榄枝，邀请她的加入，而奇怪的是，她全部都一一拒绝了，看样子似乎已经有了目标。只是星空始终不肯透露，记者们只能猜测，于是一时间，报道满天飞。机场，二楼咖啡厅，靠窗的座位上，一个极为粉嫩的小奶娃引得众人纷纷侧目！白皙的肌肤如同一块无瑕的美玉，琥珀色的眸子清澈得如同刚破冰的泉水，粉嘟嘟的小嘴吸着果汁，毫不吝啬地将那张完美的脸暴露在众人的视线里。小奶娃自动忽略一个个惊艳的目光，清亮的眸子透过明净的玻璃看向机场的出口处。那里，著名设计师星空，也就是叶芊沫，正被一群记者包围着。清雅到极致的脸，却偏偏带着几分不露痕迹的魅，高贵圣洁，却让人想要征服，人群中，她是耀眼的，而她的光芒，来源于她傲人的才华！“星空小姐，请问您回国之后有什么打算呢？”“听说只在A市就有七家集团同时邀请您加盟，请问您属意哪一家呢？”“星空……”“请问……”面对记者的提问，叶芊沫表面镇静自若地应付，在心里暗暗的哭泣，儿子，你这是要闹哪样啊！她明明在法国混得风生水起，突然接到消息说，她要回国，回毛啊，她怎么不知道她要回来啊，回来就回来吧，但是……为毛刚下飞机就遇到了记者？儿子，你是在消遣你老娘么？身在二楼的小奶娃看到自家妈咪哀怨的眼神，扭过粉嫩的小脸蛋，假装看不到，矮油，妈咪，不要用那种可怜兮兮的眼神看着人家啦，你家宝贝压力很大的！亲亲妈咪，你已经功成名就了，所以该是找个好男人的时候了，但是，某个男人在哪里呢？据说也是今天的飞机哦。于是，小奶娃眨巴着一双明亮通透的眼睛，像万能的造物主那般，等待着自己精心安排的情节慢慢上演……这时，人群中，出现了一些**！海外出口处，一群身着黑色紧身衣的专业保镖突然涌过来，推开记者，疏散人群，将出口牢牢围起来，似乎在恭敬地等待着什么人。叶芊沫好奇地看过去，然而当看到一个修长挺拔的身影出现时，顿时石化了……那是一个绝美得如同天神的男子！那张脸，明明好看得几乎模糊了男女之间的界限，却偏偏带着一丝嗜血的狠绝，身上仿佛与生俱来的王者至尊让他此刻仿佛如君临天下的帝王！他冰冷至极，却也优雅至极！尤其是那双琥珀色的眸子，仿佛汇聚了天地间所有的冷气，不带任何感情，残忍而决绝！他是……六……六年前的那个……牛郎？叶芊沫傻了，尼玛！不会这么巧吧？她刚刚回国就这么冤家路窄？六年前的那次狗血醉酒，不仅失了身，还怀了孕，要生下孩子，必须停学一年，但是，她无悔！她的选择，与孩子的父亲无关，只是因为这个孩子是她在这个世界上唯一血脉相连的亲人！这些年，她也不是没想过那个人，偶尔在梦里，她也会梦到他的样子，但是，她绝对不想再遇到他啊！现在该怎么办？逃么？可是她正被记者围住，根本逃不开……而他一步步的走过来，如同帝王，高贵地接受着世人的膜拜！“是欧总？！”记者中，不知是谁喊了一声，人群顿时沸腾起来！所有的记者纷纷准备涌上前，而就在拥挤的人群中，叶芊沫不知被谁狠狠地推了一下……思想处于放空状态，完全没有任何的防备！于是，失控的身体，就这么狼狈的冲了过去！叶芊沫眼睁睁地看着自己冲到那个尊贵男人的身边，然后身体失去平衡……已经无力挽回，摔倒在所难免！就当叶芊沫认命般地闭上眼睛，打算就这么丢人地倒在男人脚下时，身体猛然被一个力道制止！一只微带着手茧的温暖手掌紧抓住她的胳膊，另一只扣住她的腰，叶芊沫只觉得一阵晕眩，醒悟过来之后，人已经站在了那个男人面前！冷冽的气息中带着淡淡薄荷的清香，让原本大脑不清晰的叶芊沫更加头昏脑涨，只觉得有双犀利的眼睛狠狠地盯着自己！难道……他认出她了？因为当时她将他误当成牛郎，又没在房间里等他，所以他到现在还记得？怎么可能！叶芊沫心虚得不敢抬头，发现她没什么，万一发现她还有个儿子，不会把她的亲亲宝贝夺走吧？越想越害怕，叶芊沫看好退路，打算就这么灰溜溜的逃走，然而……一下秒，多镁灯光闪成一片！一个是天才服装设计师，一个是商界传奇，俊男靓女的组合，而且，现在这个传奇欧慕瑄正因为婚姻的事情绯闻当头，记者们怎么可能会放过这个镜头！“星空小姐，请问您是决定要加盟欧氏集团吗？”记者中，一个清凉的女人声音突然高声地传了进来。星空？欧慕瑄低头，想要看清她的容貌，然而她低着头，根本看不到，只觉得有种莫名的熟悉感，熟悉到内心那片永远空白的地方酸酸的，似乎有什么东西在慢慢的翻涌，慢慢的胀满……只是这一切的情绪还来不及感觉，聒噪的记者们不断涌来的提问阻断了他所有的情绪！“欧总，听说您要与莫小姐取消婚约，是因为星空小姐的原因吗？”刚刚提出问题的记者再次犀利的将两人捆在一起。于是，记者们全部都沸腾了！“星空小姐，请问您回国是为了欧总吗？”“欧总，您这次是为了特意接星空小姐回国的吗？”“你们之间的感情，欧老先生会干涉吗？”“莫小姐一直是欧氏名下女装业的负责人，欧总，您这次请星空小姐回来，是为了让她代替莫小姐吗？”“欧……”另一位记者刚刚张开口，后面的话便被突然卡在喉咙里。他的眼神，好可怕！
content_en: Chapter 1 Six years after meeting at the bar, in City A, a piece of news recently made a fuss! The talented fashion designer Xing Kong is about to return to China to develop his career! Xingkong graduated from a top university in France. At the age of 21, she amazed the entire fashion industry with a dreamlike white dress. She has since become one of the top women's clothing designers. In three years, she seems to have won all the international awards. She is also the proud disciple of the fashion queen, Master Kailin! This time, she rejected invitations from many well-known French groups and returned to China resolutely. As soon as she announced that she was going to return to China, some well-known domestic companies extended olive branches and invited her to join them. But the strange thing was that she rejected them all. It seemed that she already had a goal. But Xingkong still refused to reveal it, so reporters could only guess, so for a while, reports were flying all over the place. At the airport, in the cafe on the second floor, sitting on the window seat, an extremely pink baby girl attracted everyone's attention! Her fair skin was like a piece of flawless jade, her amber eyes were as clear as ice-breaking spring water, her pink mouth was sucking juice, and she exposed her perfect face to everyone's sight without hesitation. The little baby automatically ignored the stunning looks and looked at the exit of the airport through the clear glass with her clear eyes. There, the famous designer Xing Kong, also known as Ye Qianmo, was surrounded by a group of reporters. Her face is elegant to the extreme, but it has a certain charm that doesn't show any trace. She is noble and holy, but it makes people want to conquer her. She is dazzling among the crowd, and her brilliance comes from her proud talent! "Miss Xingkong, what are your plans after returning to China?" "I heard that seven groups in city A alone have invited you to join at the same time. Which one do you prefer?" "Xingkong..." "Excuse me..." Facing the reporter's question, Ye Qianmo responded calmly on the surface, crying secretly in her heart, son, what kind of trouble are you going to make! She was obviously prospering in France, but suddenly she received news that she was going back to China, to Mao. Why didn't she know that she was coming back? Come back as soon as she came back, but... why did Mao meet the reporter as soon as he got off the plane? Son, are you entertaining your mother? The little baby on the second floor saw her mommy's sad eyes, turned her pink face away, and pretended not to notice, "Dwarf, mommy, don't look at me with that pitiful look, your baby is under a lot of pressure!" Kiss Mommy, you have become famous, so it’s time to find a good man, but where is this certain man? It is said that this is also today’s flight. So, the little milk baby blinked a pair of bright and transparent eyes, like the omnipotent creator, waiting for his carefully arranged plot to slowly unfold... At this time, some women appeared in the crowd! At the overseas exit, a group of professional bodyguards in black tights suddenly rushed over, pushed away reporters, dispersed the crowd, and tightly surrounded the exit, as if they were respectfully waiting for someone. Ye Qianmo looked over curiously, but when she saw a slender and tall figure appearing, she was immediately petrified... That was a man as beautiful as a god! That face was so beautiful that it almost blurred the boundaries between men and women, but it still had a trace of bloodthirsty ruthlessness. The king's supremacy that seemed to be born in him made him feel like an emperor ruling the world at this moment! He is extremely cold, yet extremely elegant! Especially those amber eyes, which seem to have gathered all the cold air in the world, without any emotion, cruel and decisive! He is... the... Cowherd from six... six years ago? Ye Qianmo was dumbfounded, Damn! It can't be such a coincidence, right? She had just returned to China and she was so on the wrong side of the road? Six years ago, she was drunk and drunk. Not only did she lose her virginity, but she also became pregnant. She had to stop school for a year to give birth to a child. However, she had no regrets! Her choice has nothing to do with the child's father, just because the child is her only blood-related relative in the world! It's not like she hasn't thought about that person over the years. Occasionally, she would dream about him in her dreams, but she definitely didn't want to meet him again! What to do now? Escape? But she was surrounded by reporters and couldn't escape at all... And he walked over step by step, like an emperor, nobly accepting the worship of the world! "Is it Mr. Ou?!" Someone among the reporters shouted, and the crowd suddenly became excited! All the reporters were ready to rush forward, but in the crowded crowd, Ye Qianmo was pushed hard by someone... Her mind was in an empty state, and she had no defense at all! So, the out-of-control body rushed over in such a panic! Ye Qianmo watched helplessly as she rushed to the side of the distinguished man, and then lost her balance... There was no way to recover, and it was inevitable that she would fall! Just when Ye Qianmo closed her eyes in resignation and was about to fall humiliatingly at the man's feet, her body was suddenly stopped by a force! A slightly calloused warm hand grasped her arm tightly, and the other clasped her waist. Ye Qianmo felt dizzy. When she woke up, she was already standing in front of that man! The cold breath with the faint fragrance of mint made Ye Qianmo, whose brain was not clear at first, even more dizzy. She only felt that a pair of sharp eyes were staring at her fiercely! Could it be...that he recognized her? Because she mistook him for a cowherd and didn't wait for him in the room, so he still remembers it now? How is that possible! Ye Qianmo felt so guilty that she didn't dare to look up and found that she was fine. If she found out that she had a son, wouldn't she take her precious baby away? The more she thought about it, the more scared she became. Ye Qianmo was optimistic about her escape route and planned to run away in despair. However... in the next second, multiple lights flashed together! One is a genius fashion designer, the other is a business legend, a combination of handsome men and beautiful women. Moreover, now this legend Ou Muxuan is in the spotlight due to marriage scandals. Reporters
